event.title: International Medieval Combat Federation Championship Held at Spøttrup Castle
event.canonical_title: International Medieval Combat Federation Championship Held at Spøttrup Castle
event.summary: Nearly 600 armoured fighters from 30 countries have convened at Spøttrup Castle in Denmark for the International Medieval Combat Federation (IMCF) World Championship. The event transforms the historic fortress into a venue for full-contact historical combat, showcasing the skills of participants in a unique setting.
